assets.name: classic
assets.panel: Panels: white #FFFFFF hexagons and near-black #1B1B1B pentagons, thin dark grey seams.
assets.prompt:
Equirectangular texture map (2:1 aspect, 2048x1024) that wraps around a sphere, for a soccer ball in an original mobile tabletop soccer game. Flat albedo only: no lighting, no shading, no shadows, no specular highlights, no reflections, no 3D perspective. The left and right edges must tile seamlessly. Panel pattern of hexagons and pentagons as it appears on a truncated-icosahedron ball, unwrapped in equirectangular projection (shapes stretch near the top and bottom edges). Clean vector-like edges, slightly rounded panel seams, no text, no logos, no watermark.
Panels: white #FFFFFF hexagons and near-black #1B1B1B pentagons, thin dark grey seams.
Negative prompt: 3D render, sphere, ball shape, perspective, lighting, shadow, highlight, gloss, reflection, background scene, text, logo, watermark, border, frame.
